turns.question: Sales year to date compared with the same period last year
turns.resolved: Compare sales from January 1, 2026 through September 27, 2026 with sales from January 1, 2025 through September 27, 2025 for Volume Perf.
turns.sql:
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount) FILTER (
           WHERE so.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
             AND so.order_date < DATE '2026-09-28'
       ), 0), 2) AS sales_2026_ytd,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount) FILTER (
           WHERE so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
             AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-09-28'
       ), 0), 2) AS sales_2025_same_period,
       ROUND(
           100.0 * (
               COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount) FILTER (
                   WHERE so.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
                     AND so.order_date < DATE '2026-09-28'

               - COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount) FILTER (
                   WHERE so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
                     AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-09-28'
               ), 0)
           )
           / NULLIF(SUM(so.total_amount) FILTER (
               WHERE so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
                 AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-09-28'
           ), 0),
           2
       ) AS growth_pct
FROM sales_orders so

turns.question: Show the receivables aging report
turns.resolved: Show Acme's receivables aging report as of 2026-09-27, grouped by customer and aging bucket, using open invoice and credit note balances aged from their due dates. Use buckets for not yet due, 0–30, 31–60, 61–90, and over 90 days overdue.
turns.sql:
WITH aged AS (
  SELECT
    c.id AS customer_id,
    c.customer_code,
    c.name AS customer_name,
    CASE
      WHEN ci.due_date > DATE '2026-09-27' THEN 'not yet due'
      WHEN DATE '2026-09-27' - ci.due_date <= 30 THEN '0-30'
      WHEN DATE '2026-09-27' - ci.due_date <= 60 THEN '31-60'
      WHEN DATE '2026-09-27' - ci.due_date <= 90 THEN '61-90'
      ELSE 'over 90'
    END AS aging_bucket,
    CASE
      WHEN ci.due_date > DATE '2026-09-27' THEN 1
      WHEN DATE '2026-09-27' - ci.due_date <= 30 THEN 2
      WHEN DATE '2026-09-27' - ci.due_date <= 60 THEN 3
      WHEN DATE '2026-09-27' - ci.due_date <= 90 THEN 4
      ELSE 5
    END AS bucket_order,
    ROUND(SUM(ci.open_amount), 2) AS outstanding_amount
  FROM fin_customer_invoices ci
  INNER JOIN sales_customers c
    ON c.id = ci.partner_id
  WHERE ci.status IN ('POSTED', 'PARTIALLY_PAID')
    AND ci.open_amount > 0
  GROUP BY
    c.id,
    c.customer_code,
    c.name,
    CASE
      WHEN ci.due_date > DATE '2026-09-27' THEN 'not yet due'
      WHEN DATE '2026-09-27' - ci.due_date <= 30 THEN '0-30'
      WHEN DATE '2026-09-27' - ci.due_date <= 60 THEN '31-60'
      WHEN DATE '2026-09-27' - ci.due_date <= 90 THEN '61-90'
      ELSE 'over 90'
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN ci.due_date > DATE '2026-09-27' THEN 1
      WHEN DATE '2026-09-27' - ci.due_date <= 30 THEN 2
      WHEN DATE '2026-09-27' - ci.due_date <= 60 THEN 3
      WHEN DATE '2026-09-27' - ci.due_date <= 90 THEN 4
      ELSE 5
    END
)
SELECT
  aged.customer_code,
  aged.customer_name,
  aged.aging_bucket,
  aged.outstanding_amount
FROM aged
ORDER BY aged.customer_name, aged.customer_code, aged.bucket_order
